verdict.rationale: Forter documents an automated dispute pipeline. Chargebacks are ingested via PSP webhooks such as Stripe, a recommendation engine suggests evidence, a Request for Evidence webhook tells merchants which evidence types to send, and an Evidence API lets merchants send post-order evidence automatically instead of copy-pasting. Order status updates carry fulfillment and shipping details, and the homepage claims automated disputes. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that Forter compiles session data into the dispute package, explicit confirmation that Forter itself submits the representment to the issuer or acquirer, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, chargeback responses are automated — evidence compiled from order, delivery, and session data and submitted to the issuer without manual copy-paste

citations.quote: Save time and effort by using our Evidence API endpoint to automatically send post-order evidence for chargeback disputes.
Once chargebacks are ingested into Forter, our recommendation engine will suggest additional evidence to add to your dispute to bolster your win rate.
The Request for Evidence Webhook notifies merchants—via a Forter‑signed webhook—when we recommend uploading evidence for a specific claim, including which evidence types to send.
Inform of updates to the status of an order, including payment authorization, fulfillment, shipping details, and compensation granted.
